fields.description: Employee-side deduction rate. Pension: 8%, NHF: 2.5%, NHIS: 1.75%

fields.options:

Basic Salary
Annual Payroll
Fixed Amount

fields.description: Used when contribution basis = Fixed Amount (e.g. flat-rate levies)

fields.description: Day of the month by which remittance must reach the authority. PenCom/NSITF/NHF = 7th, PAYE = varies by state.
fields.label: Remittance Due Day (of month)

fields.description: Annual penalty rate for late remittance. PenCom = 2% p.a.
fields.label: Late Penalty Rate (% p.a.)

fields.description: How often remittance is due. PAYE/Pension/NHF/NSITF = Monthly; ITF = Annually
